For E1 exact A=max(1+tc,a+t), B=1-ta+max(0,t-c) imply A>L and B>L contradict a>1/(1+t) and a<1/(1+t). For E2 exact A=-tb+max(1,a+t), B=max(t+b,1+t-ta) force a>1 or contradictory bounds; reflected edges follow. Equality at x=(1,0), y=(t/(1+t),1) gives L=(t^2+t+1)/(1+t). Independently tested both exact witness norms at six rational t incl t>1; finite cases not used as continuum proof. At t=1 equals 3/2.
